args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding per FIN-212

The docstring claimed ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212 but the implementation
used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly
build. Import and use ROUND_HALF_EVEN instead.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was mistakenly implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

## Fix
Import and apply `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money` so half-cent values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.675 -> 2.68, 2.665 -> 2.66).

## Testing
CI run ci-0001 on commit 08d3cd5986 passed (all tests green).

Fixes the nightly build failure and ensures the fix ships in today's release.
